# CP4: quantile regression vs baselines (generated by `airalerts/models.py`)

Linear quantile regression (q10, q50, q90), refitted every day on rows dated before D:
`qr_full` on the whole history (from 2022-04), `qr_freshW` on the last W days.
Feature sets: `with_midnight` = h_lag1, h_mean7, h_mean28, ep_mean7, h_last6h, weekend, active_t0, active_elapsed_h;
`no_midnight` drops active_t0 and active_elapsed_h; `no_midnight_no_last6h` also drops h_last6h.
`+cqr` = conformalized quantile regression (added only where the pre-stated rule asks for it).

## 1. Fresh-window length (validation only, feature set with_midnight)

|    |   MAE |   coverage80 |   width |   interval_score |
|---:|------:|-------------:|--------:|-----------------:|
| 28 | 4.582 |        0.426 |   7.492 |           27.497 |
| 42 | 4.024 |        0.444 |   6.972 |           25.776 |
| 56 | 3.718 |        0.481 |   7.113 |           20.491 |
| 84 | 3.466 |        0.593 |   7.336 |           18.274 |

Chosen W = 84 (lowest validation interval score).

## 3. Does 'alert running at 00:00 and for how long' help?

Mean paired difference of daily losses (negative = the first model is better), all 3 cities,
with a 95% block-bootstrap CI (blocks of 3 days within each city, 5000 resamples).

| comparison | period | metric | mean diff | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| qr_full__with_midnight − qr_full__no_midnight | validation | MAE | +0.05 | [-0.07, +0.16] |
| qr_full__with_midnight − qr_full__no_midnight | validation | interval_score | -0.39 | [-1.17, +0.12] |

| qr_full__no_midnight − qr_full__no_midnight_no_last6h | validation | interval_score | -0.58 | [-1.52, +1.13] |
| qr_full__no_midnight − qr_full__no_midnight_no_last6h | test | MAE | -0.41 | [-0.60, -0.05] |
| qr_full__no_midnight − qr_full__no_midnight_no_last6h | test | interval_score | -0.94 | [-1.43, -0.03] |
